title: Teeth
seo_title: Year 4 Science: Teeth Worksheets (Incisors, Canines, Molars and Tooth Decay)
standard_text: Identify the different types of teeth in humans and their simple functions.
meta_desc: Free Year 4 science worksheets on teeth: incisors, canines, premolars and molars, milk and adult teeth, animal teeth and diet, tooth decay and the eggshell investigation. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Incisors cut, canines tear, molars grind; sugar and acid damage enamel.
body_html:
How to think about it

Different teeth do different jobs.

  • Incisors cut and bite; canines tear and grip; premolars and molars crush and grind.
  • Children have 20 milk teeth; most adults have 32. Teeth match an animal's diet: sharp canines for meat, flat molars for plants.
  • Sugar feeds bacteria in plaque, which make acid that decays enamel. Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste.
Example

Biting into an apple uses?

Front teeth cut

Answer: incisors

Example

Flat molars, small canines. Diet?

Grinding plants

Answer: herbivore

Common mistakes

  • Thinking molars are for biting.
  • Thinking adults have 20 teeth.
  • Thinking herbivores have big canines.

faq.q: What are the types of teeth?
faq.a: Incisors at the front cut and bite, canines tear and grip, and premolars and molars at the back crush and grind food.

faq.q: How many teeth do we have?
faq.a: Children have 20 milk teeth. These are replaced by adult teeth, and most adults have 32.
Bacteria in plaque feed on sugar and make acid, which slowly dissolves the hard enamel. Brushing and less sugar help prevent it.

items.q: Why do sugary foods cause tooth decay?
c: Bacteria in plaque turn sugar into acid that attacks enamel.
items.e: Acid damages teeth.

items.q: What is plaque?
c: a sticky layer of bacteria that forms on teeth
items.e: It makes acid from sugar.

items.q: What is the main job of canines?
items.e: Incisors cut, canines tear, premolars and molars grind.
